validFrom.description: First day the record applies, YYYY-MM-DD. No `validFrom`: since before the dataset's coverage starts.

validTo.description: Last day the record applies, YYYY-MM-DD

id.description: The arrondissement's id: an arrondissement has one boundary, which takes its key

arrondissement.description: The arrondissement the boundary belongs to

ngiId.description: The NGI's identifier of the object (its `tgid`), e.g. '{26AAD4D5-2C17-4F54-80DE-297C9683B18D}'

geometry.description: The boundary as the NGI publishes it, without simplification: WGS 84, longitude first, coordinates rounded to 7 decimals (about a centimetre)

ArrondissementBoundary.description: The boundary of a judicial arrondissement, as the National Geographic Institute (NGI) digitised it from the annex to the Judicial Code: the union of its cantons' boundaries. The legal text is the law; where the two disagree, the text wins.

ArrondissementId.description: Id of a record in data/arrondissements.json

NgiId.description: The NGI's identifier of an object (its `tgid`): a GUID in braces, uppercase

MultiPolygon.description: A GeoJSON MultiPolygon geometry (RFC 7946), in WGS 84

PolygonCoordinates.description: The rings of a GeoJSON polygon: the exterior ring first, counter-clockwise, then its holes, clockwise (RFC 7946)

Ring.description: A GeoJSON linear ring: closed (the first position repeated last), so at least four positions

Position.description: A GeoJSON position: longitude, then latitude, in decimal degrees (WGS 84)

url.description: The exact official page or file the data comes from

retrieved.description: Day the source was last checked, YYYY-MM-DD

SourceRef.description: Where a record's data was taken from
